paragraphs.text: I am applying for the summer job in IT support at Nordvik Kraft AS. I am in my second year of a bachelor's in IT and Information Systems at Molde University College, and I would like to spend the summer helping users in an IT department.
paragraphs.rationale: The opening names the position and the company, and links your degree directly to the first requirement.
linkedRequirements: Studies IT, computer science or a similar field

paragraphs.text: Alongside my studies I work as a customer service assistant at Elkjøp Molde. There I help customers set up routers and troubleshoot Wi-Fi, and I am used to explaining technical things simply. As a summer temp at the service centre in Molde Municipality, I answered enquiries by phone and email, so user support across several channels is familiar to me.
paragraphs.rationale: This is your strongest evidence for user support and networking. The paragraph uses concrete tasks from your CV rather than general qualities.
linkedRequirements: Has experience with customer service or user support

paragraphs.text: I use Windows and Microsoft 365 every day and have programmed in Python during my studies, including a group project where we built an equipment lending system with Flask and SQLite. I haven't worked with Intune or Azure yet, but I am happy to learn the tools you use, and I would like to write scripts that save the department routine work.
paragraphs.rationale: Covers the tool and scripting requirements honestly: Python is documented, while Intune and Azure are presented as something you want to learn, not something you know.
linkedRequirements: Can write simple scripts, for example in PowerShell or Python
Experience with Microsoft Intune or Azure

paragraphs.text: I am available for the whole period from week 25 to 32 and would be glad to come for an interview. Thank you for considering my application.
paragraphs.rationale: A short closing that confirms you can work the full period the posting gives.
